record.rationale: The research question is zero-shot image/video caption generation through CLIP cross-modality mapping, not a biomedical task or biological phenomenon.

record.title: Multi-objective Optimization-based Selection for Quality-Diversity by Non-surrounded-dominated Sorting
record.rationale: Quality-diversity evolutionary parent selection is developed and evaluated on synthetic functions, QDGym, robot arms and Mario environment generation; no biomedical focus.

record.title: FedBFPT: An Efficient Federated Learning Framework for Bert Further Pre-training
record.rationale: Body introduction and Section 5 establish a cross-domain BERT pre-training resource-efficiency study. JNLPBA biological NER and Rct-20k medical abstract classification are real downstream tests, but Table 3 treats them alongside SciERC as generic domain-transfer demonstrations; the ablation and layer-count case study are SciERC. Biomedical data are not the primary research focus, regardless of their numerical share of the task list.

record.title: Contrastive Label Enhancement
record.rationale: The actual objective is reconstructing label distributions from logical labels. Introduction illustrates natural scenes; Section 4 and Table 1 mix emotion, scene, movie and yeast-expression benchmarks, and measure generic distribution distances. Nine yeast subsets do not turn the research into primary gene-expression or biomedical analysis; there is no biological question or application-specific empirical interpretation.

record.title: Scalable Optimal Margin Distribution Machine
record.rationale: The paper targets computational and memory scalability of kernel optimal-margin-distribution machines using partitioning and SVRG; its stated validation concerns training efficiency and generic generalization rather than biomedical research.

record.title: c-TPE: Tree-structured Parzen Estimator with Inequality Constraints for Expensive Hyperparameter Optimization
record.rationale: This is constrained hyperparameter optimization for performance, memory and latency, with 81 expensive HPO evaluations and theoretical acquisition-function analysis, not biomedical-primary work.

record.title: Speeding Up Multi-Objective Hyperparameter Optimization by Task Similarity-Based Meta-Learning for the Tree-Structured Parzen Estimator
record.rationale: The central task is multi-objective hyperparameter optimization acceleration through task-similarity meta-learning, evaluated on tabular HPO and transformer competition benchmarks, not a biomedical problem.

record.title: PED-ANOVA: Efficiently Quantifying Hyperparameter Importance in Arbitrary Subspaces
record.rationale: The contribution quantifies hyperparameter importance within arbitrary high-performance subspaces using Pearson-divergence ANOVA; the research object is model-design efficiency, not medicine or biology.

record.title: Generalization Bounds for Adversarial Metric Learning
record.rationale: The primary contribution consists of uniform-convergence and local-Rademacher generalization bounds for adversarial metric learning; empirical validation supports the theoretical bounds, with no biomedical research objective stated.

record.title: More for Less: Safe Policy Improvement with Stronger Performance Guarantees
record.rationale: The work derives tighter safe-policy-improvement guarantees and tests SPIBB sample complexity on standard reinforcement-learning benchmarks; it does not study clinical treatment or biological systems.

record.title: Not Only Pairwise Relationships: Fine-Grained Relational Modeling for Multivariate Time Series Forecasting
record.rationale: Body Introduction and Section 4/Tables 1–2 show generic relational time-series forecasting on energy, electricity, wind, exchange rates and road/bike traffic. Healthcare appears only in introductory application motivation, not the evaluated work.

record.title: FedNoRo: Towards Noise-Robust Federated Learning by Addressing Class Imbalance and Label Noise Heterogeneity
record.rationale: Medical label quality and between-hospital disease imbalance directly motivate the method and its clinical per-class-noise assumption. Section 5 and Tables 1–2 evaluate diagnosis of five intracranial-hemorrhage subtypes in brain CT and eight skin diseases on ICH/ISIC2019. This is biomedical-primary empirical work despite a reusable federated-learning method; the study remains retrospective with simulated client partitions and injected label noise.

record.title: Singularformer: Learning to Decompose Self-Attention to Linearize the Complexity of Transformer
record.rationale: Sections 4–5 and Table 4 confirm real MIMIC-III coding and SCOPe protein-fold tests, so exclusion is not based on its generic title. However, the actual study compares Transformer accuracy, inference cost, memory and attention approximation across news, reviews, images, clinical coding and protein sequences. The SCOPe analysis diagnoses architecture rank/attention behavior rather than a protein or clinical question; biomedical datasets function as cross-domain architecture benchmarks.

record.title: ProMix: Combating Label Noise via Maximizing Clean Sample Utility
record.rationale: The study is clean-sample selection and semi-supervised learning under noisy labels, with CIFAR-N highlighted as its empirical advance; it has no primary biomedical problem.

record.title: Violin: Virtual Overbridge Linking for Enhancing Semi-supervised Learning on Graphs with Limited Labels
record.rationale: The primary task is low-label-rate graph node classification using virtual overbridges and consistency regularization. The full abstract frames general GNN representation learning, not a biomedical application or biological relationship problem.

record.title: Distilling Universal and Joint Knowledge for Cross-Domain Model Compression on Time Series Data
record.rationale: Introduction and Section 4/Tables 2–4 establish general cross-domain compression of time-series classifiers. Sleep-stage EEG classification is a real physiological benchmark, alongside phone-based activity recognition and bearing-fault diagnosis, but the analyses target teacher/student compression and domain-shift behavior rather than sleep physiology or clinical outcomes. Biomedical use is incidental to the cross-application compression study.

record.title: Expanding the Hyperbolic Kernels: A Curvature-aware Isometric Embedding View
record.rationale: Curvature-aware isometric embeddings and RKHS kernels are developed for hierarchical representation, with graph/zero-shot learning as validation; biomedical research is not the stated focus.

record.title: BARA: Efficient Incentive Mechanism with Online Reward Budget Allocation in Cross-Silo Federated Learning
record.rationale: The contribution is reward-budget allocation and auction incentives for cross-silo federated learning; final model utility and communication-round rewards are the research outcomes, not biomedical analysis.

record.title: Generalized Discriminative Deep Non-Negative Matrix Factorization Based on Latent Feature and Basis Learning
record.rationale: The work unifies shallow and deep nonnegative matrix factorization through latent feature and basis decomposition, with generic representation/clustering validation; it does not target a biomedical question.

record.title: Multi-Task Learning via Time-Aware Neural ODE
record.rationale: The study addresses competition for shared parameters in multi-task learning using time-aware neural-ODE task transformations; its stated empirical purpose is task balancing, not biological or clinical modeling.

record.title: LGI-GT: Graph Transformers with Local and Global Operators Interleaving
record.rationale: Body Sections 5.1–5.5 establish genuine molecular property/bioassay experiments, including ZINC, molpcba, NCI, BBBP and Tox21, molecule-attention interpretation and a PCBA EELA ablation, as well as synthetic PATTERN/CLUSTER and code summarization. The declared contribution and conclusions remain general graph-Transformer composition. Whether molecular work is a primary empirical research strand or a broad architecture benchmark is not resolved confidently; retain HOLD rather than decide by dataset count or generic-method title.

record.title: On the Reuse Bias in Off-Policy Reinforcement Learning
record.rationale: The paper analyzes replay-buffer reuse bias in off-policy evaluation/optimization and evaluates bias-regularized importance sampling on MuJoCo continuous-control tasks, not biomedical tasks.

record.title: Adversarial Amendment is the Only Force Capable of Transforming an Enemy into a Friend
record.rationale: Adversarial amendment is designed to improve benign image classification, object detection and segmentation performance. The research focus is adversarial-training behavior rather than a medical-image or biological task.

record.title: CLE-ViT: Contrastive Learning Encoded Transformer for Ultra-Fine-Grained Visual Categorization
record.rationale: The contribution is contrastive self-shuffling/masking for ultra-fine-grained visual category discrimination, not a biomedical question; fine-grained object categories alone do not establish biomedical primary scope.

record.title: Explainable Reinforcement Learning via a Causal World Model
record.rationale: The central object is explainable reinforcement learning via causal world-model chains linking actions, environmental variables and rewards; the full abstract does not establish a clinical or biological primary research task.

record.title: Hierarchical State Abstraction based on Structural Information Principles
record.rationale: Hierarchical state abstraction is evaluated in visual gridworld and continuous-control environments to improve RL reward/sample efficiency, not on medical or biological systems.

record.title: Dual Personalization on Federated Recommendation
record.rationale: This is personalized federated recommendation for lightweight on-device user/item models, with recommender-system personalization as the primary task.

record.title: Denial-of-Service or Fine-Grained Control: Towards Flexible Model Poisoning Attacks on Federated Learning
record.rationale: The research studies flexible poisoning attacks against federated-learning global accuracy under limited attacker knowledge; it is an ML-security contribution rather than biomedical research.

record.title: G2Pxy: Generative Open-Set Node Classification on Graphs with Proxy Unknowns
record.rationale: The work develops inductive open-set graph node classification using synthetic proxy unknown nodes and generic graph benchmarks, not a biomedical-specific discovery or prediction task.

record.title: Learning to Binarize Continuous Features for Neuro-Rule Networks
record.rationale: The primary question is end-to-end binarization of continuous features for neuro-rule networks and logic-rule learning, using differentiable intervals and clustering regularization; no primary biomedical problem is identified.

record.title: SSML-QNet: Scale-Separative Metric Learning Quadruplet Network for Multi-modal Image Patch Matching
record.rationale: Experiments explicitly concern VIS-NIR, VIS-LWIR, optical-SAR and Brown image matching; the multi-modal imaging focus is computer vision/remote sensing rather than medical imaging.

record.title: Communication-Efficient Stochastic Gradient Descent Ascent with Momentum Algorithms
record.rationale: Body Sections 5.1–5.2/Figures 1–3 verify a real melanoma test, but the research develops convergence guarantees and communication compression for distributed minimax optimization. Melanoma is one generic AUC benchmark beside converted natural-image classification; the deeper compression study is CIFAR10. This is not biomedical-primary research.

record.title: Multi-level Graph Contrastive Prototypical Clustering
record.rationale: The study concerns multi-level graph clustering objectives, semantic prototypes and representation conflicts in general GNN benchmarks, without a primary biomedical task.

record.title: Adaptive Reward Shifting Based on Behavior Proximity for Offline Reinforcement Learning
record.rationale: Adaptive reward shifting addresses offline-RL distribution shift and is tested on D4RL control benchmarks, not biomedical evidence.

record.title: Unbiased Gradient Boosting Decision Tree with Unbiased Feature Importance
record.rationale: Unbiased gain and split finding are developed for GBDT interpretability/overfitting and evaluated in a 60-dataset general feature-selection study; the core research is generic tree learning, not a biomedical objective.

record.title: DPMAC: Differentially Private Communication for Cooperative Multi-Agent Reinforcement Learning
record.rationale: The work targets privacy-preserving multi-agent communication, Nash equilibrium and cooperative RL learning stability. Human-privacy motivation does not establish a biomedical application.

record.title: LGPConv: Learnable Gaussian Perturbation Convolution for Lightweight Pansharpening
record.rationale: Pansharpening combines multispectral and panchromatic remote-sensing images; the contribution is lightweight convolutional image fusion, not medicine or biomedical imaging.

record.title: Graph Neural Convection-Diffusion with Heterophily
record.rationale: Convection-diffusion is used as a mathematical analogy for homophilic/heterophilic graph information flow; the actual task is generic graph node classification, not physical biological diffusion.

record.title: Reducing Communication for Split Learning by Randomized Top-k Sparsification
record.rationale: Introduction and Section 5/Tables 3–4 establish split-learning communication compression on CIFAR100, TinyImageNet, DBPedia and YooChoose recommendation. No biomedical experiment is present.

record.title: MAT: Mixed-Strategy Game of Adversarial Training in Fine-tuning
record.rationale: Mixed-strategy adversarial training is evaluated on GLUE and ANLI language-understanding/robustness benchmarks, not biomedical NLP.

record.title: pTSE: A Multi-model Ensemble Method for Probabilistic Time Series Forecasting
record.rationale: The contribution is an HMM-based ensemble of probabilistic forecasting distributions with convergence analysis; it is a generic forecasting method without a primary biomedical task in the full abstract.

record.title: Towards Long-delayed Sparsity: Learning a Better Transformer through Reward Redistribution
record.rationale: The study redistributes long-delayed rewards for Decision Transformers in episodic reinforcement-learning benchmarks; no biomedical treatment or physiology problem is established.

record.title: Hierarchical Transformer for Scalable Graph Learning
record.rationale: Hierarchical graph coarsening makes Transformer node representations scalable to million-node graphs; the stated question is large-graph computational efficiency and representation, not a biomedical research task.

record.title: Causal Deep Reinforcement Learning Using Observational Data
record.rationale: Medicine is mentioned only as motivation for observational-data learning. Actual Section 4 experiments and Table 2 use modified OpenAI Gym EmotionalPendulum/WindyPendulum tasks and their partially observed variants; these are control simulations, not biomedical simulations or patient data.

record.title: Prediction with Incomplete Data under Agnostic Mask Distribution Shift
record.rationale: Introduction and Section 5/Tables 1–3 verify that missingness-shift prediction is tested on synthetic Gaussian features, house prices, MNIST and DiDi traffic. The work does not evaluate a clinical or biological task.

record.title: Graph Sampling-based Meta-Learning for Molecular Property Prediction
record.rationale: Introduction frames early drug lead optimization and sparse assay labels; the molecule–property graph explicitly models correlated molecular side effects/properties. Section 4/Table 1 and analyses predict Tox21, SIDER, MUV, ToxCast and PCBA toxicity/side-effect/bioassay labels. This is biomedical drug-discovery research, not merely generic graph benchmarking; it is in-silico retrospective validation without new wet-lab or clinical efficacy evidence.

record.title: A Noisy-Label-Learning Formulation for Immune Repertoire Classification and Disease-Associated Immune Receptor Sequence Identification
record.rationale: The full abstract directly centers immune repertoire classification and disease-associated immune receptor sequence identification, evaluated on CMV and cancer data at both repertoire and sequence levels. The noisy-label method serves a primary computational immunology task, not an incidental biomedical benchmark.

record.title: Specifying and Testing k-Safety Properties for Machine-Learning Models
record.rationale: The work specifies and tests general functional-correctness k-safety properties of ML models, illustrated by bank credit screening; it is formal model validation, not biomedical research.

record.title: A Generalized Deep Markov Random Fields Framework for Fake News Detection
record.rationale: The primary task is semi-supervised fake-news detection on social media through deep Markov random fields and event removal, not biomedical misinformation or medical evidence analysis.

record.title: StockFormer: Learning Hybrid Trading Machines with Predictive Coding
record.rationale: StockFormer explicitly optimizes stock trading, portfolio returns and Sharpe ratios on financial datasets; it lies outside biomedical scope.
